text:
clare: Quick sync on landing + webinar gating for the tiered launch. Need compact hero + explicit routing so growth and sales can build flows. Drafts below.

ana: Short runway today 680. I'll review copy and confirm webinar CTA wording.

clare: Hero draft 1: "One API for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private inference."
Topline: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency, costs you can plan for, and enterprise controls when you need them."
CTA primary: "Start free trial" -> hosted_signup
CTA secondary: "Request demo" -> dedicated_lead_form
CTA tertiary: "Private trial request" -> private_se_inbox

hugo: For the public benchmark line, can we say "typical median latency <100ms for common classification workloads"? Short and less technical than p99.

clare: Love that. Updated hero copy: "One API for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private inference."
Topline updated: "Predictable latency, optimized unit cost, and enterprise controls. Typical median latency <100ms for common text workloads."

tina: Webinar gating idea: add two quick selects on the form: 1) "primary objective" (experiment / production / compliance) 2) "infrastructure" (cloud / on-prem / VPC). That helps routing.

clare: Agreed. Proposed routing rules (web team):
```
form fields:
- tier -> hosted / dedicated / private
- objective -> experiment / production / compliance
- infra -> cloud / vpc / on_prem

routing logic:
if tier == 'hosted' -> marketing.signup.selfserve (auto-activate trial)
else if tier == 'dedicated' -> sales.queue.dedicated_priority (assign AE)
else if tier == 'private' -> solutions.queue.private_eval (assign SE)

if objective == 'compliance' and tier != 'private' -> flag for compliance_followup
```

ana: For SFDC we should include lead_score calc: webinar_opt_in + company_size + infra choice. If company_size >= 500 -> bump to enterprise routing.

hugo: Nitty: private copy should mention KMS + audit logs, but keep short. e.g., "Bring Redwood into your VPC or on-prem with KMS and audit logs."

clare: Great. Social/web copy variations for launch announcement (short):
- variant A: "Redwood Inference: a single API for hosted experiments, dedicated throughput, or private deployments."
- variant B: "Ship reliable LLM features—hosted, dedicated, or private—without replatforming."

tina: For webinar CTA on landing, suggest two CTAs: "Register for webinar" (captures nurture) and "Watch demo" (immediate demo for high-intent).

growth-bot: [preview-deploy] Landing v2 pushed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview-launch (valid 72h) :rocket:

clare: Plan: lock copy by EOD PT. Growth will draft nurture sequence for dedicated leads (touches: intro email, webinar invite, technical case study, AE outreach). Anyone want to run an A/B on variant A vs B for the hero?

ana: I can set up A/B and capture click-through on primary CTA. Put it in the web ticket and tag me.

hugo: Minor SEO note: include keywords "inference API", "dedicated GPU inference", "private LLM deployment" in the page meta and h2s.

clare: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll finalize copy and upload final markdown to the staging link.

tina: No objections from me. :white_check_mark:
